datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Zimbabwe to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Survey results were spatially aggregated and classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing severity levels from minimal to catastrophic food insecurity, with geographic boundaries mapped in GeoJSON and KML formats for 2022.
